title: Bouncy Boots
description: This datapack adds a small new armor piece called Bouncy Boots!
body:
# Bouncy Boots!
Have you ever wanted to jump around like crazy similar to a Sulfur Cube?

### **Well you got into the right place!** 

- This simple datapack adds new boots called Bouncy Boots. With them you become, well, very bouncy and fast. These boots also increase the maximum height from which you take damage, how neat!

- The boots have a very simple recipe, 2 iron ingots ans 2 sulfur blocks.!![Bouncy Boots crafting recipe.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04556688bc1d1607cfc8c86e05d4dd0e47eac10d.png)


## HOW TO INSTALL:
- Download both the datapack and resource pack from the Versions tab.
 
- Install the datapack in the datapack folder, and the resource pack in the resource pack folder.
